evidence.answer_defining_proposition: マルチローターは着地後にコントローラーでローターの回転を停止させる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 着地すればローターを回したまま回収してよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: touchdown complete -> maintain control authority -> command rotor stop with controller -> recovery

collision.note: Tier A。Q183はヘリコプターでローター停止まで人が近づかない規則。本問はマルチローター操縦者が着地後に行う停止操作を問う。

independent_review.rationale: The source explicitly requires a multirotor pilot to stop rotor rotation with the controller after touchdown. Q183 is helicopter-specific and tests when a person may approach the aircraft, not the pilot shutdown action. Aircraft applicability and answer-defining action differ.

director_adjudication.rationale: Adopt the independent review at ACCEPT 6 / REJECT 0. All six answer-defining propositions are directly supported by second-class-applicable Chapter 5 source text and remain distinct from their named canonical neighbors. C001 and C004 are controlled boundary variants with distinct flight phases and required actions, not wording-only variants. C006 adds the TEM Threat-to-Error-to-UAS causal management chain rather than repeating broad CRM resources or the five CRM skills. No quota backfill is required or permitted.
